title: Safety with response to the problem
text: It's fun to get the boxes. I have been getting them for 9 months or so now. If I can't use something like eyelashes I give to my daughter. Bad part is my skin was ok to begin with. Now I'm  breaking out my face  really burns all the time. I got an eye mask that had poorly written English instructions and product info. It absolutely did not make since. This product was from China. I don't want products from China. I try not to be racist but to many products are not safe from this country. I contacted  Allure and got a polite brush off without any comment to this product. I'm thinking about cancelling and I'm going back to my old facial products (loreal) to get my skin straightened out.
label: neutral
